answer: Cross-agent correlation scoring. The system logs each agent’s action sequence relative to others and flags near-identical timing plus content overlaps as a possible clone set. A lantern score rises when distinct identities share rare action patterns, and a tide threshold retires low-diversity accounts from rewards. Authority review confirms an oasis of independent behavior before reinstatement. Cost: attackers must generate genuinely divergent histories per identity, multiplying coordination and review workload for every clone kept active.
